newsitem.title: UK: Reuters adds share database to UK service.
newsitem.headline: Reuters adds share database to UK service.

text.p: Global news and information group Reuters Holdings Plc said on Monday it would add a large UK shareholder database to its Equity Focus Plus service for UK and Ireland equities clients.
Reuters said the provision of the "Citywatch" database would be free and exclusive.
The database contains information on the share registers of all UK-listed companies, showing how many shares are owned by fund managers and other parties.
The Citywatch service will be delivered by the Reuters web, an extranet for Reuters clients.
